question: What are flight numbers of flights arriving at City "Aberdeen"?
gold_query: SELECT T1.FlightNo FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRPORTS AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport   =  T2.AirportCode WHERE T2.City  =  "Aberdeen"
